title: My Only Love
description: “My Only Love” is a story about seeing someone special again, remembering the feelings that never faded, and learning that real love sometimes means being happy for someone, even when life takes you on different paths.
subtitle: Since 2010...

title: SOULMASK EP170
description: Unfortunately, the RNG gods weren't on my side today—no luck this time around, but the grind doesn't stop. We're still clearing out the remaining objectives in the Cloud Mist Forest before we even think about touching the Shifting Sands.
subtitle: A new feeling is coming...

title: SOULMASK EP169
description:
After a long wait, Shifting Sands has finally been released—but I’m not moving to the new map just yet.
I want to finish Cloud Mist Forest first, so in this episode I head to the Phosphate Mine, hoping to tame a powerful new tribe member and learn its positive traits.
subtitle: A new feeling is coming...
